newsitem.title: MEXICO: Mexico same-day peso ends weak, qtr-end dlr demand.
newsitem.headline: Mexico same-day peso ends weak, qtr-end dlr demand.

text.p: The same-day peso closed weak on end-of-quarter and -month demand for dollars from dealers who had not yet covered positions on Friday, traders said.

"Several corporations had yet to cover end-of-month dollar positions and that was putting pressure on the peso," a trader said. "However, the peso may firm up as the session progresses, as no one is buying dollars at current levels."
Traders said that most dealers had already covered their end-of-month dollar positions on Friday.
The same-day peso recovered ever so slightly from opening losses to close 2.25 centavos weaker at 7.5445/7.5480 per dollar.

The benchmark 48-hour and the 24-hour peso were meanwhile 1.10 and 1.30 centavos weaker, respectively, at 7.5520/7.5550 and 7.5480/7.5520 per dollar. These contracts also improved just a touch from opening lows.

Traders said they did not expect higher U.S. 30-year Treasury bond yields to have their usual adverse affect on the peso, as there were few foreign investors left in the Mexican markets with peso positions to sell.
